name: Katanaya Ao
source:
A cool and handsome idol. Her appearance, voice and behavior are cool enough to rival any man, but in reality, she's actually the most feminine and fragile of the group. She has a striking outfit with a strong-looking chain and iron hairpins, all exuding coolness.
[Translated from [url=https://cream-nohana.fanbox.cc/posts/8667943]Fanbox[/url]]
